attr.title: The Swapper
attr.desc: A puzzle-platformer set aboard an abandoned space station, built around creating and swapping between clones.
attr.inst: Purchase The Swapper on Steam, download the Windows depot with `download_depot 231160 231161 5334393392610826601`, and copy its files into `ports/theswapper/gamedata`.
attr.inst_md:
### Steam Instructions
* [Open Steam console](steam://open/console)
* Copy and paste command: `download_depot 231160 231161 5334393392610826601`
* Copy the downloaded files into `ports/theswapper/gamedata`.

The folder should contain `TheSwapper.exe`, `mainSettings.ini`, and the `data` directory.
